sections.title: Habit and cultivation
sections.text: Cucumber is a trailing or climbing annual with tendrils; its stems can reach about 5 m. It has palmately lobed leaves and yellow flowers. The fleshy fruits are usually elongated but vary among cultivars and are harvested green or ripe.

sections.title: Fruit and comparison
sections.text: The fruits are eaten fresh or preserved as pickles. The plate shows cultivated green forms with flowers and tendrils. Like melon, Cucumis melo, cucumber belongs to the genus Cucumis; its fruits are usually harvested green and are less sweet, though forms vary.
